### Config
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ── Outcome selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Choose one: "avg_g" | "title_distance" | "ref_distance" | "cross_domain" | "keyword"
# "keyword" is special: the panel holds one kw_<keyword>_rate column per keyword
# (from did_analysis_paper_keyword.py) and every one of them is estimated in turn.
dataset <- "keyword"

# ── Parameters (must match did_analysis*.py) ──────────────────────────────────
k                     <- 3
min_papers_per_year   <- 2
same_domain_control   <- FALSE   # TRUE: samedomain, FALSE: anydomain
reference_threshold   <- 1
citation_threshold    <- 1
min_year              <- 1950
max_year              <- 2025 - k
MIN_FSO_YEAR          <- 1990

# Resolve paths relative to THIS .Rmd's location (not the working directory), so it
# works whether knit or run interactively in RStudio.
rmd_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input())),
  error = function(e) {
    if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
      dirname(normalizePath(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
    } else {
      getwd()
    }
  }
)

# Input DiD panels from did_analysis_paper_*.py: META_DIRE/full_text_online_analysis
data_dire <- file.path(rmd_dir, "..", "data", "full_text_online_analysis")
# Output event-study coefficient CSVs go to the R_generated subdir, where
# plot_event_study.py reads them (META_DIRE/full_text_online_analysis/R_generated).
save_dire <- file.path(data_dire, "R_generated")
dir.create(save_dire, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# One event-study figure per outcome is written here -- for dataset == "keyword"
# that is one file per keyword. Same folder plot_event_study.py writes to
# (openalex/figures/full_text_online_analysis).
fig_dire <- file.path(rmd_dir, "..", "figures", "full_text_online_analysis")
dir.create(fig_dire, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
FIG_EXT    <- "png"   # "png" | "pdf" | "svg" (svg needs the svglite package)
FIG_WIDTH  <- 6
FIG_HEIGHT <- 4

domain_tag <- if (same_domain_control) "samedomain" else "anydomain"

# ── Dataset configurations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_cfg <- list(
  avg_g = list(
    file_mid    = "",
    outcome_var = "avg_g",
    controls    = "avg_log_citation_y5 + avg_log_up_refer_count + log_paper_count",
    label       = "avg_g"
  ),
  title_distance = list(
    file_mid    = "paper_title_distance_",
    outcome_var = "avg_title_distance_y5",
    controls    = "avg_log_citation_y5 + avg_log_up_refer_count + log_paper_count",
    label       = "avg title distance (y5)"
  ),
  ref_distance = list(
    file_mid    = "paper_ref_distance_",
    outcome_var = "avg_ref_distance_y5",
    controls    = "avg_log_citation_y5 + avg_log_up_refer_count + log_paper_count",
    label       = "avg ref distance"
  ),
  cross_domain = list(
    file_mid    = "paper_cross_domain_",
    outcome_var = "avg_cross_domain_ratio_y5",
    controls    = "avg_log_citation_y5 + avg_log_up_refer_count + log_paper_count",
    label       = "cross-domain ratio"
  ),
  keyword = list(
    file_mid    = "paper_keyword_",
    outcome_var = NA_character_,   # resolved after loading: every kw_*_rate column
    controls    = "avg_log_citation_y5 + avg_log_up_refer_count + log_paper_count",
    label       = "P(keyword in title)"
  )
)

cfg <- all_cfg[[dataset]]
outcome_var <- cfg$outcome_var

input_file <- file.path(
  data_dire,
  paste0("did_panel_", cfg$file_mid, domain_tag,
         "_k", k,
         "_mpy", min_papers_per_year,
         "_rt", reference_threshold,
         "_ct", citation_threshold,
         "_miny", min_year,
         "_maxy", max_year,
         ".csv")
)

cat("dataset:", dataset, "\n")
cat("outcome_var:", outcome_var, "\n")
cat("input_file:", input_file, "\n")
cat("k:", k, "\n")
cat("same_domain_control:", same_domain_control, "\n")
cat("min_papers_per_year:", min_papers_per_year, "\n")

# ── Helper: extract fixest coef table with CI ─────────────────────────────────
get_coefs_fixest <- function(model) {
  ct <- as.data.frame(coeftable(model))
  ct$term <- rownames(ct)
  colnames(ct)[1:4] <- c("estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value")
  ci <- as.data.frame(confint(model))
  ci$term <- rownames(ci)
  colnames(ci)[1:2] <- c("conf.low", "conf.high")
  merge(ct, ci, by = "term")
}
```

### Load & prepare data
```{r}
df <- fread(input_file)
cat("rows loaded:", nrow(df), "\n")

# Derived controls
df[, log_paper_count := log(paper_count + 1)]

# Factors for fixed effects
df[, venue_issn_f     := as.factor(venue_issn)]
df[, treatment_year_f := as.factor(treatment_year)]
df[, top_domain_f     := as.factor(top_domain)]
df[, year_index_f     := as.factor(year_index)]

# treated: is_control == 0
df[, treated := as.integer(is_control == 0)]

cat("treatment venues:", df[is_control == 0, uniqueN(venue_issn)], "\n")
cat("control  venues:", df[is_control == 1, uniqueN(venue_issn)], "\n")
cat("year_index range:", range(df$year_index), "\n")

# ── Outcomes to estimate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Every dataset but "keyword" has a single outcome; "keyword" has one column per
# keyword, so the event study below runs once per column.
if (dataset == "keyword") {
  outcome_vars <- grep("^kw_.*_rate$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(outcome_vars) > 0)
  # kw_<keyword>_rate -> <keyword>, used for labels and coefficient file names
  outcome_keys   <- sub("_rate$", "", sub("^kw_", "", outcome_vars))
  outcome_mids   <- paste0(cfg$file_mid, outcome_keys, "_")
  outcome_labels <- paste0("P('", outcome_keys, "' in title)")
} else {
  outcome_vars   <- cfg$outcome_var
  outcome_mids   <- cfg$file_mid
  outcome_labels <- cfg$label
}
cat("outcomes to estimate:", length(outcome_vars), "\n")
print(outcome_vars)
```

### Regression (event study) + plot
One model per outcome: a single one for the scalar datasets, one per keyword for
`dataset == "keyword"`.
```{r}
df[, year_index_f := relevel(year_index_f, ref = "-1")]

models   <- list()
coef_tbl <- list()

for (i in seq_along(outcome_vars)) {
  ov    <- outcome_vars[i]
  label <- outcome_labels[i]
  mid   <- outcome_mids[i]

  fml <- as.formula(paste0(
    "scale(", ov, ") ~ treated * year_index_f + ",
    cfg$controls,
    " | venue_issn_f + treatment_year_f"
  ))

  m <- tryCatch(
    feols(fml, cluster = ~ venue_issn_f, data = df),
    error = function(e) { cat("SKIPPED", ov, "->", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(m)) next
  models[[ov]] <- m

  cat("\n================ ", ov, " (", label, ") ================\n", sep = "")
  print(summary(m))

  int_fe <- get_coefs_fixest(m) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "^treated:year_index_f")) %>%
    mutate(ri = as.integer(str_extract(term, "-?\\d+$")))

  # Add reference period at -1 (estimate = 0, omitted by fixest)
  int_fe <- bind_rows(
    int_fe,
    data.frame(term = NA, estimate = 0, std.error = NA,
               statistic = NA, p.value = NA,
               conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0, ri = -1L)
  ) %>% arrange(ri)
  coef_tbl[[ov]] <- int_fe

  # Save event-study coefficients
  out_coef <- file.path(
    save_dire,
    paste0("event_study_coefs_", mid, domain_tag,
           "_k", k,
           "_mpy", min_papers_per_year,
           "_rt", reference_threshold,
           "_ct", citation_threshold,
           ".csv")
  )
  write.csv(
    int_fe[, c("ri", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")],
    out_coef, row.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("Saved coefs to:", out_coef, "\n")

  p <- ggplot(int_fe, aes(x = ri, y = estimate)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_line(size = 1, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,    linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("DID Event Study: ", label, "  (k=", k, ", mpy=", min_papers_per_year, ")"),
      x     = "Year Index (relative to treatment year)",
      y     = "Estimated Coefficient (treated × year_index)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)

  # one figure per outcome (per keyword when dataset == "keyword")
  out_fig <- file.path(
    fig_dire,
    paste0("event_study_", mid, domain_tag,
           "_k", k,
           "_mpy", min_papers_per_year,
           "_rt", reference_threshold,
           "_ct", citation_threshold,
           ".", FIG_EXT)
  )
  ggsave(out_fig, plot = p, width = FIG_WIDTH, height = FIG_HEIGHT, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved figure to:", out_fig, "\n")
}
```

### Post-vs-pre summary across outcomes
A single post-treatment DID coefficient per outcome — for `dataset == "keyword"`
this is the table that says which keywords the intervention moved.
```{r}
df[, post := as.integer(year_index >= 0)]

post_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(outcome_vars), function(i) {
  ov <- outcome_vars[i]
  if (is.null(models[[ov]])) return(NULL)
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(
    "scale(", ov, ") ~ treated * post + ", cfg$controls,
    " | venue_issn_f + treatment_year_f"
  ))
  m <- tryCatch(feols(fml, cluster = ~ venue_issn_f, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
  ct <- as.data.frame(coeftable(m))
  r  <- ct["treated:post", ]
  data.table(outcome = ov, label = outcome_labels[i],
             estimate = r[[1]], std.error = r[[2]],
             statistic = r[[3]], p.value = r[[4]])
}))

post_tbl <- post_tbl[order(p.value)]
print(post_tbl)

out_post <- file.path(
  save_dire,
  paste0("did_post_effects_", cfg$file_mid, domain_tag,
         "_k", k, "_mpy", min_papers_per_year,
         "_rt", reference_threshold, "_ct", citation_threshold, ".csv")
)
fwrite(post_tbl, out_post)
cat("Saved post-vs-pre effects to:", out_post, "\n")
```
